area: ZPA identity: Path analyzer what-if, Test a list and the ZPA builder
title: ZPA access policy evaluated for an IdP, a user's SCIM groups and SAML or SCIM attribute values, with the condition that decided; access rules over SCIM groups and SAML attributes

checks.what: Oracle tables: a condition's operands join by its operator (OR unless AND), a negated condition is inverted, unknown operands stay unknown unless the others settle it
Oracle tables: a rule's conditions join by its operator (AND unless OR); rules are walked in order, a disabled rule skipped, first match decides, no match is default deny
SCIM groups looked up and attribute values typed decide the access rules; the verdict names the identity condition that decided and the earlier rules that do not apply, with why
An attribute not given, a failed SCIM lookup, a filter ZPA did not apply and a partial membership list each stay unknown with the reason, never a match
A SCIM group, SCIM attribute or SAML attribute of another IdP is not met; SCIM conditions with SCIM-based policy off and SAML ones with SAML-based policy disabled are not met
A ZPA identity, a list with identity columns and the IdP and user pickers are refused with 400 before sign-in when ZPA is not ticked or the input is not valid
SCIM lookups are kept only for the run (no cache across runs), at most 200 users per run and 50 group names shown; Stop ends a lookup; logs carry counts, never the user name, a group or a value
The lookup uses list_scim_groups(idp_id, scim_user_name) and list_scim_attributes(idp_id) as zscaler-sdk-python 1.11.3 defines them, scim_user_name sent as scimUserName; read-only

Builder access rule over picked SCIM groups and SAML values: preview names them, the SDK's v1 condition template is used (verified against PolicySetControllerV1), read-back confirms, a re-run changes nothing, Undo restores
Builder picks are validated before any read (ids, at most 20 each, value 1-200 characters with no control characters, Access ticked) and checked again against the tenant in the preview
Test a list reads idp, SCIM user and attributes columns, evaluates each row's ZPA answer for its identity and looks each user up once per run

In a browser: pickers off out of scope, IdPs and groups drawn as text (markup runs nothing), the start request carries the identity typed, the result block names what decided, every control named and focusable, no sideways scroll at 320px

findings.title: The Path analyzer's ZPA step treated every user as 'any user': SCIM group, SCIM attribute, SAML attribute and IdP conditions were never evaluated, so identity-scoped access rules stayed conditional
findings.fix: zpa_identity.py: an IdP, a SCIM user's groups looked up read-only for the run and typed attribute values feed zpa_analysis.evaluate_rule; the verdict names the deciding identity condition

findings.title: With an IdP given, a SCIM group condition of another IdP still matched a group of the same name, and a SAML condition of another IdP matched typed values
findings.fix: zpa_analysis._other_idp: an identity operand of another IdP, or of an IdP with its SCIM- or SAML-based policy off, is not met

findings.title: The ZPA builder's access rule could only allow every user: no SCIM group or SAML attribute condition
findings.fix: ops_zpa: access_scim_groups and access_saml picked from the tenant, checked in the preview, written with the SDK's v1 condition tuples, compared on read-back and restored by Undo
